combos.label: Secure attention sequence
combos.note: Reserved by Windows at the kernel level; cannot be intercepted or rebound.

combos.label: Lock computer
combos.note: Reserved by Windows; cannot be overridden by applications.

combos.label: Window switcher
combos.note: Reserved by Windows; cannot be reliably overridden.

combos.label: Window system menu
combos.note: Also opens Copilot on some Windows 11 configurations.

combos.label: Screenshot / Snipping Tool
combos.note: Windows 11 opens the Snipping Tool on PrtScn by default (configurable in Settings → Accessibility → Keyboard).

combos.label: Help
combos.note: Opens help in most Windows applications; a global F1 binding will shadow that.

keyNotes.label: Full screen in browsers
keyNotes.note: Browsers and many apps toggle full screen on F11; a global binding will shadow that.

keyNotes.label: Developer tools in browsers
keyNotes.note: Browsers open developer tools on F12; a global binding will shadow that.

keyNotes.label: Free, ideal remap target
keyNotes.note: Windows defines VK_F13 through VK_F24 but assigns them no system function. Rarely conflicts: some vendor utilities, AutoHotkey scripts, OBS or Stream Deck setups also listen for them.

keyNotes.label: Free, ideal remap target
keyNotes.note: No default Windows function (VK_F14). See the F13 note about macro/streaming tools.

keyNotes.label: Free, ideal remap target

keyNotes.note: No default Windows function (VK_F24). Occasionally emitted by vendor macro keys.

keyNotes.label: State toggle
keyNotes.note: Usable as a hotkey on Windows, but it still toggles caps state. Prefer remapping it on the board itself via VIA.

keyNotes.label: State toggle
keyNotes.note: Toggles numpad state when pressed, even if bound.

keyNotes.label: Mostly free
keyNotes.note: Rarely used by modern software (Excel is the notable exception).
